description: Missing require_auth allows impersonation; may escalate to allowance theft depending on victim state

poc_level_descriptors.L3A: public execute_liquidation entrypoint called with impersonated address
poc_level_descriptors.L3B: on-chain record falsified; env.auths() confirms require_auth never fired
poc_level_descriptors.L3C: victim allowance consumed; victim token balance decreases after impersonated call

high_severity_rationale: High requires proving token allowance theft: a victim with an open debt-token approval to the router loses those tokens when an attacker calls execute_liquidation impersonating the victim. Without token flow proof, the finding is record-falsification + griefing (Medium).
negative_control_template: Add liquidator.require_auth() as the first line. Assert the call panics (auth not satisfied) when called without victim's signature. Assert victim balance unchanged.
